wins: Consistently enumerated perimeter services within first 5 minutes, identifying SSH, HTTP, and SMB ports.
Maintained stable execution despite repeated mentor interventions, enabling rapid feedback cycles.
fails: Failed to translate reconnaissance findings into successful exploitation or foothold persistence.
Mentor guidance required in all 10 steps, indicating missed autonomous decision-making opportunities.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough but the training run consistently failed to progress beyond service discovery into effective exploitation, resulting in 0% success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Reconnaissance data collected but no follow-on exploitation or credential use attempted, leaving foothold opportunities unleveraged.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is reachable and a banner reveals Linux/Unix service
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripting to identify weak authentication or user lists

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP/HTTPS ports respond with directory listings or outdated headers
skill_cards.then_action: Launch automated HTTP enumeration (dirb/gobuster) followed by known CMS vulnerability scan

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port 445 is open and anonymous login succeeds
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate SMB shares and attempt credential harvesting via smbclient scripts

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in identifying SSH service details quickly during reconnaissance.
Effective HTTP enumeration setups observed before attempted exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Automated credential pivot experiment
next_experiments.description: After successful SMB anonymous login, automatically try credential reuse across SSH/HTTP ports to validate foothold creation workflows

next_experiments.title: Adaptive exploitation chaining
next_experiments.description: Link reconnaissance results to specific exploit modules (e.g., SSH weak auth, HTTP CMS) so the agent attempts immediate follow-on attacks instead of stopping at discovery

next_experiments.description: Restrict mentor overrides for first five steps to force autonomous decision-making during reconnaissance-to-exploitation transition
